Title: Dinosaur Extinction
Content: The hypothesis that an asteroid strike led to the mass extinction of dinosaurs is widely accepted. It is understood that the asteroid strike caused a massive and quick shift in `text(Earth’s)` temperature and blocked much of the sunlight. While devastating for the dinosaurs, this dramatic event provided opportunities for other species. For example, surviving birds and mammals underwent a time of rapid evolution, which led to the `text(thousands)` of birds and mammal species present on `text(Earth)` today.
